He played college basketball for the [[Memphis Tigers men's basketball|Memphis Tigers]] before being selected 17th overall in the [[2006 NBA draft]] by the [[Indiana Pacers]]. ==High school career== Considered a five-star recruit by [[Rivals.com]], Williams was listed as the No. 5 shooting guard and the No. 15 player in the nation in 2005.[https://sports.yahoo.com/footballrecruiting/basketball/recruiting/player-Shawne-Williams-37052;_ylt=AixXQ1syhoNUDMjZXkhwqclGPZB4 Shawne Williams Recruiting Profile] ==College career== In his freshman year of 2005–06 at Memphis, Williams averaged 13.2 points and 6.2 rebounds per game while also averaging 1.4 steals and blocks, playing in 36 games while starting 34. He led all [[Conference USA]] freshmen in scoring and rebounding. Williams averaged 18.0 points and 6.7 rebounds in three games in the Conference USA tournament, being named the tournament MVP. He can also play at the guard position. ==Professional career== Williams signed with the [[Indiana Pacers]] July 6, 2006. Williams scored 13 points in his NBA debut against the Chicago Bulls on December 11, 2006.{{citation needed|date=March 2024}} On October 10, 2008, Williams was traded to the [[Dallas Mavericks]] for [[Eddie Jones (basketball)|Eddie Jones]], two first-round draft picks and cash.{{cite web | url=http://www.nba.com/mavericks/news/ShawneWilliams.html | title=Mavericks Acquire Forward Shawne Williams | work = [[NBA.com]] | date = 2008-10-10 | accessdate = 2010-12-04}} [[File:Shawne Williams of the New York Knicks - 20091005.jpg|thumb|left|Williams as part of the Knicks in 2010]] On January 11, 2010, the Mavericks traded him and [[Kris Humphries]] to the [[New Jersey Nets]] for [[Eduardo Nájera]].{{cite web | title = Nets Acquire Kris Humphries and Shawne Williams from Dallas | url = http://www.nba.com/nets/news/Najera_Humphries_Trade_Release_100111.html | work = [[NBA.com]] | date = 2010-01-11 | accessdate = 2010-01-12}} Four days later, the Nets waived Williams.{{cite web | title = Nets Waive Shawne Williams | url = http://www.nba.com/nets/news/Shawne_Williams_Waived_Release_100115.html | work = [[NBA.com]] | date = 2010-01-15 | accessdate = 2010-12-04}} On September 23, 2010, the [[New York Knicks]] signed Williams to a one-year contract.{{cite web | title = Knicks Sign Shawne Williams | url = http://www.nba.com/knicks/news/williams_100923.html | work = [[NBA.com]] | date = 2010-09-23 | accessdate = 2010-12-04}} Williams had his best season with New York, playing a key role off the bench for the team as the Knicks reached the 2011 NBA playoffs.{{citation needed|date=March 2024}} On December 15, 2011, the [[New Jersey Nets]] signed Williams to a two-year contract, beating the offer made by the New York Knicks.{{cite web | title = Shawne Williams passes on re-signing with Knicks, will join Nets | url = http://www.nydailynews.com/sports/basketball/knicks/shawne-williams-happy-nj-nets-article-1.992955 | work = nydailynews.com | date = 2011-12-17 | accessdate = 2011-12-17}} On March 15, 2012, the Nets traded Williams, [[Mehmet Okur]], and a [[Damian Lillard|2012 first-round draft pick]] to the [[Portland Trail Blazers]] for veteran small forward [[Gerald Wallace]]. Williams never appeared in a game for Portland. In early 2013, Williams joined Guangzhou Liu Sui for the 2013 [[National Basketball League (China)|NBL]] season. On September 3, 2013, Williams signed with the [[Los Angeles Lakers]].{{Cite web|url=https://www.nba.com/lakers/releases/130903shawnewilliams|title=Lakers Sign Shawne Williams|website=www.nba.com}} He was waived on January 7, 2014, the deadline before his contract would become guaranteed. The Lakers had injuries to guards [[Kobe Bryant]], [[Steve Nash]], [[Steve Blake]], [[Jordan Farmar]], and [[Xavier Henry]], and wanted to free up Williams' roster spot and salary in the event they later need another replacement at guard.{{Cite web|url=http://www.insidehoops.com/blog/2014/01/los-angeles-lakers-waive-shawne-williams/|title=Los Angeles Lakers waive Shawne Williams – NBA Blog – NBA Basketball Blog|date=January 7, 2014}}{{cite news|last=McMenamin|first=Dave|title=GM: Players have too much at stake|date=January 8, 2014|work=ESPN.com|url=https://www.espn.com/los-angeles/nba/story/_/id/10265090/mitch-kupchak-says-los-angeles-lakers-give-struggles|archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20140109151448/http://espn.go.com/los-angeles/nba/story/_/id/10265090/mitch-kupchak-says-los-angeles-lakers-give-struggles|archive-date=January 9, 2014|url-status=live}} On January 27, 2014, Williams was acquired by the [[Los Angeles D-Fenders]] of the [[NBA D-League]].{{Cite web|url=http://www.nba.com/dleague/dfenders_acquire_shawne_williams_2014_01_27.html|title=D-Fenders Acquire Shawne Williams|website=[[NBA.com]] }} On February 6, 2014, he re-signed with the Lakers to a 10-day contract.{{Cite web|url=https://www.nba.com/lakers/releases/140206shawnewilliams|title=Lakers Sign Shawne Williams|website=www.nba.com}} He did not sign a second 10-day contract with the Lakers after his first 10-day contract expired. On February 19, 2014, he was re-acquired by the D-Fenders. On August 1, 2014, Williams signed with the [[Miami Heat]], rejoining former Pacers teammate [[Danny Granger]].{{cite web|url=http://www.nba.com/heat/news/heat-signs-shawne-williams|title=Heat Signs Shawne Williams|work=NBA.com|publisher=Turner Sports Interactive, Inc.|date=August 1, 2014|accessdate=August 1, 2014}} On February 19, 2015, Williams was traded to the [[New Orleans Pelicans]] in a three-team trade involving the [[Phoenix Suns]].{{cite web|url=http://www.nba.com/pelicans/news/pelicans-complete-three-team-trade-miami-phoenix|title=Pelicans Complete Three-Team Trade with Miami, Phoenix|work=NBA.com|date=February 19, 2015}} Three days later, he was waived by the Pelicans.{{Cite web|url=https://www.nba.com/pelicans/news/pelicans-waive-shawne-williams|title=Pelicans Waive Shawne Williams|website=www.nba.com}} On February 24, 2015, Williams was claimed off waivers by the [[Detroit Pistons]].{{Cite web|url=https://www.nba.com/pistons/features/pistons-add-depth-shooting-claiming-veteran-shawne-williams-waivers|title=Pistons add depth, shooting by claiming veteran Shawne Williams off waivers|website=www.nba.com}} On June 11, 2015, Williams was traded, along with [[Caron Butler]], to the Milwaukee Bucks in exchange for [[Ersan İlyasova]].{{cite web|url=http://www.nba.com/bucks/bucks-acquire-forwards-caron-butler-and-shawne-williams-pistons|title=Bucks Acquire Forwards Caron Butler and Shawne Williams From Pistons|work=NBA.com|date=June 11, 2019|website=asia-basket.com|accessdate=January 21, 2019}} == Personal life == On September 11, 2007, Williams was [[arrested]] in [[Indianapolis]], Indiana on a charge of possession of [[marijuana]]. Two passengers in Williams' car were also arrested. One was charged with possession of marijuana, the other was charged with possession of a stolen [[handgun]].{{Cite web|url=http://www.indystar.com/apps/pbcs.dll/article?AID=/20070912/SPORTS04/709120428/1247/SPORTS|title=Pacers' Williams faces 4 charges}} In January 2010, Williams was arrested in Memphis on felony drug charges for selling a codeine substance.{{Cite web|url=http://www.commercialappeal.com/news/2010/jan/15/nba-player-former-memphis-tiger-shawne-williams-ar/|title=Former Memphis Tiger Shawne Williams indicted, arrested on drug charges}} Williams later pleaded guilty in April to misdemeanor drug possession. He was placed on six months' probation, ordered to undergo mandatory drug testing, attend a drug offender school and make a $10,000 contribution to the Shelby County Drug Treatment Court. His legal situation cleared up quickly. During the summer of 2010, Williams received training camp invitations from two teams: the New York Knicks and Charlotte Bobcats. Williams' older brother, who was murdered, last saw him play at the Madison Square Garden. As a result of this sentimental connection, Williams chose to attend the Knicks' training camp.[http://dimemag.com/2010/12/shawne-williams-is-the-knicks-comeback-kid/ Dime Q&A: Shawne Williams is the Knicks’ comeback kid] On December 13, 2012, Williams was arrested again in Memphis on drug charges after a police officer smelled marijuana coming from a Porsche in a parking lot near a mall. In the car, officers found a partially smoked joint of marijuana, as well as another joint and a bottle of codeine cough syrup that was not prescribed to Williams.{{Cite web|url=http://www.cbssports.com/nba/eye-on-basketball/21401856/former-nba-journeyman-shawne-williams-facing-drug-charges|title=Former NBA journeyman Shawne Williams facing drug charges}} From 2011 to 2013 Williams dated Little Rock model Molly Mclane. As of 2024, Williams is married to rapper and ''[[Love & Hip Hop: Atlanta]]'' cast member Jessica Dime. They have a daughter named "Blessing" born in 2018 and a son named "Wisdom" born in 2023.{{Cite web|url=https://www.vh1.com/news/j5dvld/jessica-dime-engaged-to-nba-player-shawne-williams|title = Off the Market: Jessica Dime is Engaged to NBA Player Shawne Williams}} == NBA career statistics == {{NBA player statistics legend}} === Regular season === {{NBA player statistics start}} |- | align="left" | {{nbay|2006}} | align="left" | [[2006–07 Indiana Pacers season|Indiana]] | 46 || 3 || 12.1 || '''.469''' || .365 || .550 || 1.8 || .5 || .1 || .2 || 3.9 |- | align="left" | {{nbay|2007}} | align="left" | [[2007–08 Indiana Pacers season|Indiana]] | '''65''' || 3 || 14.9|| .427 || .314 || .717 || 2.7 || '''.9''' || .4 || .4 || 6.7 |- | align="left" | {{nbay|2008}} | align="left" | [[2008–09 Dallas Mavericks season|Dallas]] | 15 || 0 || 11.3 || .286 || .059 || .818 || 3.1 || .1 || .1 || .6 || 2.8 |- | align="left" | {{nbay|2010}} | align="left" | [[2010–11 New York Knicks season|New York]] | 64 || 11 || 20.7 || .426 || '''.401''' || .837 || 3.7 || .7 || '''.6''' || '''.8''' || '''7.1''' |- | align="left" | {{nbay|2011}} | align="left" | [[2011–12 New Jersey Nets season|New Jersey]] | 25 || 6 || 20.6 || .286 || .241 || .727 || 2.7 || .6 || .4 || .4 || 4.5 |- | align="left" | {{nbay|2013}} | align="left" | [[2013–14 Los Angeles Lakers season|L.A.
